final.summary: Two similar prior decisions among the issues shown: one recorded a fix, the other judged its credential not exploitable. Six more were closed without a stated reason.

precedents.title: Hard-coded credential in the mailer configuration

precedents.title: Hard-coded credential in the scheduler configuration
